body_markdown:
Beam Global (NASDAQ: BEEM) CEO Desmond Wheatley joins ScoutDI CEO Nicolai Husteli to discuss Beam Global’s Beam Global (NASDAQ: BEEM) CEO Desmond Wheatley presents at the LD Micro 20th Annual Main Event on October 21, 2026.


In this presentation, Desmond Wheatley discusses Beam Global’s business, technologies and strategic vision as the company advances its solutions across clean transportation, energy storage and intelligent infrastructure.


Beam Global develops innovative, sustainable infrastructure solutions designed to support energy resilience, electrification and critical power needs.


About Beam Global


Beam Global (NASDAQ: BEEM) is a clean technology innovator specialising in sustainable energy infrastructure, including off-grid EV charging, advanced battery technology and energy storage solutions.
